tei:div.tei:p: EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid brtag pa'o: dbang chen yab yum gnyis su med la 'dud: las ldan gsang sngags rnal 'byor pas: zung 'jug bde ba chen po yis: tshe gcig byang chub bsgrub 'dod pas: dbang chen yab yum zhal sbyor 'di: shin tu zab pas nyams su blang : rgya rgya rgya: de nyid nyams su blang ba la: klong gsal las: mtshan dang ldan pa'i rig ma dgos: mtshan ngan 'phrad na dmyal bar ltung : de phyir brtag pa'i thabs bstan no: zhes pas: brten bya dang spang bya gnyis las: dang po brten bya'i rig ma ni: dung can ma zhes bya ba'i rigs: sha dkar byang sems snying rje che: ngo bzhun spyod lam shin tu dal: lus rgyas skad ni phra la snyan: phyi ltas theg chen chos la mos: gsang rtags gsang tshig mi smra zhing : nang rtags rtsa sna dung bzhin yod: sgrub pa po la gus pa 'o: glang sna ma yi rigs dag ni: spyod lam dal zhing lhun sdug chags: gsus khyim che la nya sul rags: mig 'dzum che zhing gdong mig lta: sems bzang smras pa'i zla bo brtan: blo brtan ci byed sos dal ba: nang rtags rtsa sna shin tu ring : gsang rtags sbyor ba dag la mkhas: ngang rgyud ring zhing dul ba 'o: ri dwags can gyi rigs bstan pa: stod smad phyed dang spyod lam mdzes: skra yi yan lag zlum 'dril mgyogs: nang gi rtags su rtsa sna ni: bya rog mchu bzhin yod pa yin: gsang rtags ba ga rub pa dang : sgrub pa po la gus pa 'o: pad+ma can gyi mtshan nyid ni: ha cang ring min thung pa'ang min: skra bzang smin phrag gnyer ma gsum: gyen la 'greng zhing 'dzum mdangs che: de bzhin nu phrag gsang gnas su: gnyer chung gsum ni gyen la 'greng : shes rab che zhing snying rjer ldan: dri zhim gom pa g.yon nas 'dor: nang rtags ba ga rub cing zho 'thung 'dra: gsang rtags yid 'ong bde ba rgyas: de nyid pad+ma can zhes bya: yongs su phyi yi mtshan nyid ni: dbyibs dang kha dog skad dang dri:

spyod lam rig pa'i sgo dang ni: bsags rgyab che chung dbang po brtag: dang po dbyibs la brtag pa ni: mchu zhing 'dzum zhing zlum pa dang : pad+ma lta bur mdangs dang ldan: phra dang sbom pa'i skyon med cing : mnyen lcu gas 'khril ldem mdzes pa dang : lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od du 'phro: so tshags dam zhing bag tsam thung : smin phrag yangs shing smin ma 'khyug: 'dzum mdangs che zhing lta bas mdzes: stod smad sked skabs mgul pa legs: gang nas bltas kyang skyon dang bral: de ni dbyibs la brtags pa 'o: gnyis pa kha dog brtag pa ni: snum zhing dkar sogs mdangs dang ldan: mig rtsa dmar la dkar nag phyed: mig dkyus ring zhing dpral 'dzum phyed: so mdangs dkar la mchu snyan dmar: ma mchu bag tsam ring ba dang : lag mthil sen mo dmar ba dang : zangs san lcags kyi kha rgyan can: mdun rgyab gang nas bltas kyang mdzes: gang ltar 'dug kyang mdangs dang ldan: skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i mi: de nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rigs: mthong ba tsam gyis ye shes 'phel: de ni kha dog brtags pa 'o: gsum pa skad la brtag pa ni: dri mdangs phyed cing snyan pa dang : gog dang 'dzer ba'i skyon med pa: ngang pa ka la ping ka'i dbyangs: ri dwags skad bzhin gsang ba la: dal khug snyan cing dar dang ldan: smra brjod tshig sgo gsal ba dang : go zhing phyi nang thams cad du: 'dzum che bden zhing gsong por smra: de ni skad la brtags pa 'o: bzhi pa dri la brtag pa ni: tsan dan ga bur gla rtsi'i dri: ngag dang lus las bro ba dang : kha nas dri ngan mi bro zhing : mchan 'og bse dri med pa dang : gsang gnas sha rul dri ma med: yongs su dri zhim ldan pa 'o: dri ngan bde ba bzlog pas ngan: dri bzang bde ba skyed phyir bzang : de ni dri la brtags pa 'o: lnga pa spyod lam brtag pa ni: ci byed sos dal ngang nas byed: rgyab nas bltas na dgyes pa 'dra: mdun nas bltas na sgu bar mngon:

zur nas bltas na shin tu drang : gtsang sbra dkon mchog rten la mos: bla ma la sogs mi chen la: dad 'dun spyod lam mdzes pa shes: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rigs yin pas: reg pa tsam gyis bde ba skye: de ni spyod lam brtags pa 'o: drug pa rig pa sgo yi brtag pa ni: rig pa gsal la rnam shes grung: yid gzhungs dran bzung shes rab che: phyin ci log la mi 'jug pa: sems nyid zhi dul byams pa che: khyad par a ti'i chos la mos: de ni rig pa sgo yi rtags: bsags rgyab che chung dbang thang ni: tshogs bsags rigs bzang chos pa'i bu: ya rabs spyod pa kun dang ldan: zas nor 'phel zhing thams cad byams: gzhan yang sngags skyes ma zhes pa: pha ma gsang sngags grub thob bu: sha dkar lus smad rgyas pa la: sna rgyud legs shing nu ma 'bur: nu phrag dog la dam tshig gtsang : bde ba snying la 'bar bar nus: zha ིnga skyes ma zhes bya ba ni: zhing skyong mkha' 'gro mi lus blangs: rtags ni gzugs legs kha dog gtsang : dpral mdangs che la mig dkyus ring : ngag snyan gad rgyangs ha ha sgrogs: mi snang bsgyur nus zil yang che: las skyes ma zhes tha mal gyi: bu mo legs pa'i rtags tshang ba: mthong ba tsam gyis ye shes skye: sbyor ba byas na zag med skye: ting 'dzin rgyud la 'phel ba 'byung : gzugs legs spyod lam mdzes pa la: skyes pa mthong na gdong mig lta: stod smad sha rgyas sked pa phra: yan lag sha khengs gtsang sbra che: yid 'dzum che zhing bde ba che: gsang thub kha nyung brtse gdung che: brtan zhing blo gsal rig pa rno: kun mthun shes pa dang ka 'dren: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rigs yin pas: de 'phrad nor zas 'gro ba 'du: ting 'dzin nyams rtogs rgyud la skye: yon tan nor bu rin chen 'dra'o: EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s mtshan ngan ma dag rigs bstan pa: skra rtsub nag la bong chung thung : mig ser che la phra ma mkhas: chos la mi dad sdig la dga': mdza' grogs ngan la gdung ba che:

go ba shes chung phyin log mkhas: drin bzhag kha lan rngams la smra: bden pa khyad gsod kha rbad che: legs nyes ngo dgar snyoms pa dang : bzang lan ngan gyis blan pa rnams: bdud mo dam sri'i rigs yin spang : mdog nag skra rtsub sul rags mgyogs: drag la 'jigs shing tshig zur rno: khon 'thab 'dzem pa med pa dang : mig ser 'phongs su tsha bcug 'dra: gang dang 'grogs 'khon su nye 'tshig: gtsang sbra chung la dmar la rngams: smra phod che la ko long dam: zhe sdang rags la khro gtum mang : khong khro che zhing kun la 'dzugs: klu bsen rigs yin spang bar bya: blo sho rgod la sdig sdig 'gro: rting pa leb la tshig sna mang : blo ni mi brtan 'gyur ldog che: mig ser tshad nad langs pa 'dra: gzugs byad ngan la blo sems che: kha nas rta bong dri chen mnam: mchan 'og bse dri mnam pa dang : gsang gnas sha rul dri ma mnam: zhen pa dong kha ldog pa dang : mdzes pa'i rnam pa gang yang med: phra men gnod sbyin rigs yin spang : EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s mche ba yod la mig dmar zhing : mig khung dma' la mkhur tshos mtho: mig ser nan la 'dod chags che: rkan phug nag la gdong dreg chags: mkhur tshos che la og ko rno: sha skem sen mo bya sen 'dra: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i rigs yin spang : sna nyag mkhur tshos mtho ba dang : gsus pa che la 'phong rus chung : dpung mgo dma' la tshigs pa sbom: bsam blo mang la mig ser che: sha rtsub dri ngan bong sbang mnam: gsang mi thub la ko long dam: yi dwags dam sri'i rigs yin spang : de rnams brten pa'i nyes pa yis: mkha' 'gro chos skyong mi chags dang : dam tshig 'khon gyi dri ma 'ong : rims dang mi yi gshe skur 'ong : 'khor gyi bsod nams bri ba dang : tshe thung nad mang dgra bgegs 'byung : EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s gzhan yang rigs ngan las skal zad: mthong ba tsam gyis grib 'byung spang : sha za khrag 'thung rkang 'jibs ma:

bcud 'phrog ma dang rnam pa bzhi: 'di bzhi bdud mos mi lus blangs: sha za'i rigs ni 'di lta ste: mdog nag bud med skyes pa'i skad: gzi ma ring la smin ma sob: gzugs ngan gsang gnas g.ya' chu mang : kha btsog sbyor ba'i khyer kha med: sbyor thabs mi shes byol song 'dra: ro nyal rlan 'dor 'dod chags che: de nyid brten na dngos grub med: tshe la bar chad 'byung bar 'gyur: EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s khrag 'thung ma yi rigs bstan pa: gdong dang kha ni shin tu dmar: lus po 'khang la yan lag gyong : gnyen lcugs 'bol ba'i sha rjud med: skra rtsub khro mig 'dzum dang bral: lus sbom sha rtsub dreg pa chags: mchan 'og spu dang sma ra can: mdzub mo sen mo bya sder 'dra: de dang 'phrad na dngos grub zad: tshe 'phos mnar med dmyal bar 'khrid: gsanath+ya: rkang 'jib ma yi rigs la ni: skra nag g.yag mgo lta bur li: mig sprin khra la gzi ma ring : rmi lam lha mthong 'dre mthong zer: gdong drag har la pho skad 'don: mig ser snying la zin pa 'dra: tshig rtsub lud pa phyogs bcur 'phen: mi nor mi chags zas bcud chung : bre la la bya ba mi 'grub pa: sems tshub kha gdong bzhin phug sdud: de dang 'phrad na dngos grub zad: tshe la bar chad myur du 'byung : bcud 'phrog ma yi rigs la ni: sha mdog skya thal ser thal lam: sngon mo nag bem smug bem mam: skra nag lus kyi dri ma nag: mig ser che la zas la ngan: skyes pa dag dang 'bral mi phod: mig 'bras dma' la sna gong nyag: gos dang rgyan gyi khyer kha med: lus kyi rtsa dang bral ba dang : khrus med skra yi gnyer mi 'ong : grong khyer grong stong nyul ba rem: tshig rtsub phra ma'i brtson 'grus che: kha 'chal gtam la rdzogs pa med: de brten tshe thung nad mang zhing : rnal 'byor lus kyi nyams shed chung : gzhan yang nyes pa shin tu che: lan gcig brten yang skyon cig 'byung : rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyis spong :

nor dang longs spyod snyan pa yang : de dag brten pa tsam gyis yal: skye bo'i mi kha 'byung ba dang : mi mthun phyogs rnams 'phel bar 'gyur: gzugs ngan yid du mi 'ong dang : lus la dri ngan yod pa gsum: phyag rgya'i lus kyi skyon gsum yin: rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub gsum: phyag rgya'i ngag gi skyon gsum yin: mos gus chung la the tshom che: log lta'i skyon brjod dbang po gsal: phyin ci log la rig pa rno: phyag rgya'i yid kyi skyon gsum yin: zhig dang zha dang gud pa gsum: phyag rgya'i rtsa yi skyon gsum yin: sku gsung thugs kyi sme ba dang : sna bug g.yas pa'i sme ba ni: skyon rnams sel zhing yon tan rdzogs: zhes gsungs so: phyag rgya'i mtshan bzang ngan rtags tshad la phab pa: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gsungs pa: jo mo mtsho rgyal la phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor chags can don du gdams pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: bkra shis so: : mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (5)ḍāk+ki'i lam 'bras kyi skor/ - PAGE 410 -- PAGE 409 - - PAGE 408 -
